head.name: @fzlt/core/view-canvas
head.lead: One overlay canvas per root, sized for the screen's pixel density and redrawn only where something changed. The canvas covers the root's padding box (pointer-events: none, so the root keeps its input), its backing store is the CSS size × devicePixelRatio (capped by maxDpr), and drawing is in CSS px. - Dirty redraw: dirty([x, y, w, h]) grows one box (no arguments: the whole canvas); in the render phase that box, snapped out to whole device pixels, is cleared, clipped and handed to draw. Nothing dirty, nothing drawn: a still view costs no canvas work at all. - Settle: it never keeps the engine awake; dirty() wakes a settled engine for one redraw. - Layout reads only in the read phase, and only after a resize or a zoom (a ResizeObserver). - Recall: the canvas goes and the root's style comes back exactly (the engine's ledger). It has no motion of its own: reduced motion belongs to whatever moves the drawing.

sizesNote: Measured on this build: minified and gzipped with everything it imports, the way npm run size checks the budget in CI.
